entity: White Birch Apartments, Milwaukee (HUD Section 8 rent vs fair market rent)
what_we_add: White Birch named; $2,574 a unit a month, 223% of fair rent, highest ratio for a 100+ unit building in a cheap market outside Puerto Rico
why: The only source, a 1998 HUD OIG audit, finds 1,219 subsidized projects with rents over 150% of fair rent: same kind of finding. It doesn't name White Birch; 14 queries logged.
